-- Finale Platzregel: Buchungsanzahl, bezahlte Koepfe und groesste kostenlose Gruppe. Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT p.booking_id,
           coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
           coalesce(p.quantity, 0) AS menge,
           CASE WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '(bis zu|max\\.?|f\\.|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}[0-9]+[[:space:]]*person'
                THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)(?:bis zu|max\\.?|f\\.|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*person'))::int END AS basis_n,
           CASE WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '[0-9]+[[:space:]]*(personen|person|teiln|teilnehmer)'
                THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*(?:personen|person|teiln|teilnehmer)'))::int END AS text_n,
           (p.pricecategory_name ~* '(jede|je|pro)[[:space:]]+weitere|preis[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*für[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*jede[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*weitere') AS ist_zusatz
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
           max(pos.basis_n) AS basis_n, max(pos.text_n) AS text_n,
           coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.ist_zusatz), 0) AS zusatz_n,
           coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat = 'Inklusive'), 0) AS inklusive_n,
           bool_or(pos.kat = 'Inklusive') AS hat_inklusive
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    LEFT JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, 4
),
kopf AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           CASE WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN basis_n + zusatz_n
                WHEN text_n IS NOT NULL THEN text_n
                WHEN hat_inklusive THEN 1 + inklusive_n + zusatz_n
                ELSE 1 END AS abgeleitet
    FROM je_buchung j
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht') AS buchungen,
           coalesce(sum(k.abgeleitet) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht' AND k.netto <> 0), 0) AS bezahlt,
           coalesce(max(k.abgeleitet) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht' AND k.netto = 0), 0) AS groesste_gratisgruppe,
           greatest(
               count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht'),
               coalesce(sum(k.abgeleitet) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht' AND k.netto <> 0), 0),
               coalesce(max(k.abgeleitet) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht' AND k.netto = 0), 0)
           ) AS plaetze,
           round(coalesce(sum(k.netto) FILTER (WHERE k.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN kopf k ON k.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Regelentscheidung' AS bereich,
           CASE WHEN plaetze = buchungen THEN 'buchungsanzahl'
                WHEN plaetze = bezahlt THEN 'bezahlte koepfe'
                ELSE 'groesste gratisgruppe' END AS kennzahl,
           count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('buchungen ', sum(buchungen), ' / bezahlt ', sum(bezahlt),
                  ' / gratismaximum ', sum(groesste_gratisgruppe), ' / plaetze ', sum(plaetze)) AS hinweis
    FROM je_termin WHERE buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Ueberbuchung final',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(name, 40)),
           plaetze::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', user_maximum, ' / buchungen ', buchungen,
                  ' / bezahlt ', bezahlt, ' / gratismaximum ', groesste_gratisgruppe,
                  ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND plaetze > user_maximum

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Auslastung ab 2023',
           CASE WHEN user_maximum IS NULL OR user_maximum = 0 THEN 'ohne hoechstzahl'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum > 1 THEN 'ueber 100 prozent'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.75 THEN '75 bis 100 prozent'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.5 THEN '50 bis 75 prozent'
                WHEN plaetze::numeric / user_maximum >= 0.25 THEN '25 bis 50 prozent'
                ELSE 'unter 25 prozent' END,
           count(*)::numeric,
           concat('plaetze ', sum(plaetze), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start >= '2023-01-01' AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Jahresmittel final',
           concat('jahr ', extract(year FROM date_start)::int),
           round(avg(plaetze::numeric / user_maximum) * 100, 1),
           concat('termine ', count(*), ' / plaetze ', sum(plaetze),
                  ' / hoechstzahl ', sum(user_maximum), ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE user_maximum > 0 AND buchungen > 0
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Kontrolltermin',
           concat(to_char(date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(name, 40)),
           plaetze::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', user_maximum, ' / buchungen ', buchungen,
                  ' / bezahlt ', bezahlt, ' / gratismaximum ', groesste_gratisgruppe,
                  ' / netto ', netto)
    FROM je_termin
    WHERE date_start IN ('2022-11-21', '2022-11-22', '2022-11-28', '2022-12-01',
                         '2023-05-05', '2023-07-19', '2024-02-02', '2024-11-05', '2026-05-21')
)
SELECT 'S41' AS schritt, count(*) AS zeilen,
       string_agg(concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
                  chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl) AS bericht
FROM roh;
